description: This file defines the internal class SiloStatusListenerManager, which manages ISiloStatusListener instances, handles subscription and unsubscription, processes membership updates asynchronously, and notifies listeners of status changes within the Orleans runtime's membership service.

classes.name: SiloStatusListenerManager
classes.description: Manages silo status listeners, handles their subscription lifecycle, processes membership updates, and notifies listeners of status changes within the Orleans runtime.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Adds a new ISiloStatusListener to the manager if it is not already subscribed.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes an existing ISiloStatusListener from the manager.

methods.name: ProcessMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Asynchronously processes membership table updates and notifies registered listeners of changes.

methods.name: NotifyObservers
methods.description: Notifies all registered listeners of membership status changes.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the manager to lifecycle events for starting and stopping membership update processing.

methods.name: LogDebugStartingToProcessMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Logs the start of membership update processing.

methods.name: LogErrorProcessingMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Logs errors encountered during membership update processing.

methods.name: LogDebugStoppingMembershipUpdateProcessor
methods.description: Logs the stopping of the membership update processor.

methods.name: LogErrorCallingSiloStatusChangeNotification
methods.description: Logs errors when calling the status change notification on a listener.
